features: vm.measureMemory uses a native JSC full-collection marked graph, with actual realm reachability boundaries and engine cell size estimates plus deduplicated backing allocations. Exclusive/shared/unattributed ownership derives bounded ranges; shared estimates divide actual reachable allocation weights instead of duplicating the whole heap for each context.

Default requests wait for full collection; eager requests trigger it. Results post asynchronously to the owning context, overlapping requests retain independent promises, and native requests retire on process/worker shutdown and test-realm replacement.

The initial generic cell-size implementation failed to distinguish unequal indexed arrays. Actual backing-capacity accounting corrects that failure without changing its assertion. Native unequal-allocation, lazy collection, overlap and shutdown controls pass.
limitations: The full dead-context lifetime control remains failed: evaluated contexts stay reachable after references are dropped. The no-measurement control and installed Bun show the same retention; unused contexts collect. #885 tracks the actual owner/lifetime gap, and #870 remains open. No row suppression or weakened lifetime assertion is used.

Copy-on-write/shared backing proof, every memory type, profiler interactions, all-platform/Release/ASAN and full Bun-suite remain incomplete. Values are JSC graph-based estimates and ownership ranges; exact V8 byte totals are not claimed.

Deliberate reporter negatives and the separate failed lifetime control retain their outcomes. Two upstream TODOs receive no pass credit. Initial compile errors, backing-store failure, disk refusals, stale-cache integration failure and bare-selector mixed-root regression failure remain retained. The selector-only attempt also failed. The actual dispatcher fix preserves distinct roots/caller context; the original regression arguments and assertions are restored.
Final explicit Pickier scans match one preexisting error and eleven warnings, zero new findings. Zig formatting and documentation path checks pass.
